during pre-release.]] The User Interface (abbreviated as UI) is the part of the game mechanic the player uses to interact with the game. The term generally refers specifically to the buttons, windows, and other controls the player sees when playing the game. In many games, the developers made allowances for enterprising players to craft their own unique look-and-feel for their gamespace. The player can modify ("mod") just their own client application, or one can upload one's UI mod to one of the many fansites that host file transfers. Players can also download mods by peers and use those UI mods with their client. In World of Warcraft, mods are called AddOns. By swapping out UI mods, the ent

The administrative, business, financial, and legal relationship with Blizzard Entertainment that gives you access to play World of Warcraft. When you login to the game, the billing status of your user account gets verified to prove you have paid to play the game.

The term use means to interact with fixed devices or items to produce some desired (or undesired) effect or generally anything you can right-click with your character that isn't just selecting. This includes such mundane actions as checking your mail, drinking, eating, fighting (use a weapon), and reading scrolls. It also includes items that say "Use: ..." in their tooltip.
These are cut-and-paste functions that you can use in your addons, submitted by Wowpedia contributors.

Upper Blackrock Spire is the upper area of Blackrock Spire. The area of the Blackrock Spire instance to the north of the Hall of Blackhand is commonly known as Upper Blackrock Spire. It is treated as an independent instanced dungeon from Lower Blackrock Spire, although it is in fact part of the same, huge instance. The instance is a raid with 10 player cap. After patch 4.0.3a it was updated to be a 5-man dungeon. Before patch 3.0.8 the raid required completion of the quest Seal of Ascension (quest), to acquire the Seal of Ascension. UIDropDownMenuTemplate is a FrameXML Frame template that can be used to create contextual menus and dropdown boxes in World of Warcraft. This tutorial explains how to use it in your addon. Ursolan is an area in Azshara just east of Timbermaw Hold. It is characterized by a deep scar running through the middle of it, full of Talrendis Biologists. Ursolan's namesake is Ursol, a Kalimdor bear demigod revered by the furbolg race.

Urchins come in several varieties including, purple, black, and orange. They inhabit tide pools and the shores around coral reefs. It is dangerous to step on them, as they are likely poisonous, or can cause infections. If poison or infection doesn't kill the individual, then pissing on the open sore can be used to sterilize the wound. Urchins are found around the Broken Isles.

The armies that wage war on the battlefield exact a heavy toll on the economies that support them. Even the lowliest of fighters has living expenses that must be met. Their armor must be oiled, their bows strung, and their weapons kept in clean condition. In short, these armies require Upkeep. In Warcraft III, Upkeep takes the form of a tax on your Gold mining that is automatically deducted from all Gold you gather. As you produce more units, the tax on your Gold income increases. There are three levels of Upkeep: * No Upkeep (0-50 Food: 100% income): No Upkeep occurs when you have an army consuming 50 food or less. It was filled up with the souls of the Jambani trolls by the Horde adventurer on Zul's orders and then used to sabotage Vol'jamba's precautions, meaning as he died, his soul tried to entered the urn, but to no avail. Afterward, Zul picked the urn and went away with it.
Unworthy Vessels are mawfiends created by Nazmani Supplicant in Uldir.

Urjad is a void revenant located in the Seat of the Triumvirate.

Unusually Large Mushroom has a small chance to drop from any mob in Ardenweald, Mists of Tirna Scithe, or De Other Side. It can be planted in the Damp Loam in northwestern Ardenweald to spawn a Rapidly Growing Mushroom which eventually transforms into the rare elite Humon'gozz, who in turn drops the Arboreal Gulper mount when killed.

Upio is a tuskarr sleighing on a small isle west of the Azure Archives in the Azure Span.
Urlostrasz is a red drake located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.
The Used Mud Mask is an ooze found sitting next to two Spa Guests at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
